audit.method: Idle fresh profile, every request logged and refused by a local proxy (tests/baseline/connection-audit).
audit.limits: Entries marked 'pref' were not seen in the idle audit: they are browsing-time connections, switched off by a preference whose value was verified, not their absence on the wire.

connections.name: Remote Settings
connections.purpose: Downloads security data: blocklists of harmful add-ons, certificate revocation data (CRLite), intermediate certificates.
connections.sees: Your IP address and when the browser checks for new data. Not the sites you visit.
connections.decision: Keep. Security data; Klin relies on CRLite instead of OCSP.
connections.ifOff: Revoked certificates and harmful add-ons would no longer be detected.

control.note: No safe switch. Turning it off also disables certificate revocation checks.

connections.name: Browser updates
connections.purpose: Checks for and downloads new browser versions.
connections.sees: Your IP address, browser version, operating system and language.
connections.decision: Keep. Timely security updates are mandatory (specification 4.5).
connections.ifOff: Known security holes stay open until you update by hand.

connections.name: Safe Browsing lists
connections.purpose: Downloads lists of known phishing and malware sites. Pages are checked against the local copy.
connections.sees: Your IP address and when the lists are refreshed. Not the sites you visit.
connections.decision: Keep, user-switchable. Privacy versus protection trade-off still open (see docs/PROPOSALS.md).
connections.ifOff: No warning on known phishing and malware pages.

connections.name: Add-on metadata and updates
connections.purpose: Checks installed extensions for updates and fetches their descriptions.
connections.sees: Your IP address and the list of installed extensions.
connections.decision: Keep while extensions are installed: extension updates are security updates.
connections.ifOff: Extensions, including the ad blocker, stop receiving fixes.

connections.name: uBlock Origin download
connections.purpose: First start only: downloads uBlock Origin, as required by the Klin policy.
connections.sees: Your IP address and that uBlock Origin is being installed.
connections.decision: Remove by bundling uBlock Origin in the build.
connections.ifOff: No ad and tracker blocking until uBlock Origin is installed another way.

control.note: Goes away once uBlock Origin ships inside Klin.

connections.name: uBlock Origin filter lists
connections.operator: uBlock Origin project and list maintainers (hosted on GitHub, Cloudflare, jsDelivr, GitLab)
connections.purpose: Updates the lists of ads, trackers, malware domains and cookie banners to block or hide.
connections.sees: Your IP address and when the lists are refreshed. Not the sites you visit.
connections.decision: Keep. Blocking quality depends on fresh lists (specification 4.2).
connections.ifOff: Blocking slowly gets worse as lists age.

control.note: In the uBlock Origin dashboard. The cookie-notice lists are switched on by Klin's policy and are not bundled: they are only downloaded.

connections.name: Web Push
connections.purpose: Keeps a permanent connection open so sites can send notifications while closed.
connections.sees: Your IP address, all the time the browser is running.
connections.decision: Disabled. A permanent background connection is against low impact.

control.note: Set both to true to re-enable.

connections.name: Region detection
connections.purpose: Guesses your country to choose regional defaults such as the search engine.
connections.sees: Your IP address, from which the country is derived.
connections.ifOff: Regional defaults are not adjusted automatically.

control.note: Set the first to true and reset the second to re-enable.

connections.name: Captive portal and connectivity checks
connections.purpose: Pings a test page to detect Wi-Fi login pages (hotels, trains) and whether the network works.
connections.sees: Your IP address, repeatedly, on every network you join.
connections.ifOff: Public Wi-Fi login pages are not opened automatically; open any http page to reach them.

control.note: Set both to true to re-enable.

connections.name: OpenH264 codec download
connections.purpose: Downloads a video codec used for H.264 in video calls.
connections.ifOff: Video calls that only offer H.264 may not work. Normal video playback is not affected.

connections.name: Firefox Accounts and Sync
connections.purpose: Sign-in and synchronisation through a Mozilla account.
connections.sees: Your IP address and, when signed in, your account.

control.note: Also locked by the DisableFirefoxAccounts policy.

connections.name: Certificate status lookups (OCSP)
hosts: the certificate authority of each site
connections.purpose: Asks the authority that issued a site's certificate whether it has been revoked.
connections.sees: Your IP address and which site you are opening, usually over unencrypted HTTP.
connections.decision: Disabled. Revocation is checked locally with CRLite.
connections.ifOff: A certificate not covered by CRLite gets no revocation check.

connections.name: Search suggestions and trending searches
connections.purpose: Sends what you type in the address bar to the search engine to show suggestions, and asks it for trending searches when you click the bar.
connections.sees: Your IP address and every character typed, before you press Enter.
connections.decision: Disabled. Nothing is sent until you search.
connections.ifOff: No suggestions from the search engine while typing.

control.note: Set both to true to re-enable.

connections.name: Speculative connections
hosts: sites linked from the page or guessed from typing
connections.purpose: Connects in advance to sites you might open next, to save a moment if you do.
connections.sees: Your IP address, on sites you never chose to visit.
connections.ifOff: The first load of a new site can be slightly slower.

control.note: See config/prefs/klin.js for the Klin values.

connections.name: Sponsored tiles, recommendations and built-in AI downloads
connections.purpose: Fetches sponsored shortcuts, recommended articles, add-on recommendations and VPN promotions, and downloads models for Firefox's own on-device AI features.
connections.sees: Your IP address and that you opened a new tab or the add-ons page.
connections.decision: Disabled. Klin shows no advertising or sponsored content (specification 6); its AI is opt-in and uses local Ollama (specification 4.8).
connections.ifOff: No sponsored or recommended content, no Firefox AI features such as smart tab groups.

control.note: Set to true to re-enable. Destinations beyond contile.services.mozilla.com not yet confirmed on the wire.
